change: + adaptive threshold (151 px Gaussian window, C=10) as the last cascade step
why: T5: in all 19 empty images the egg stays fused with a bright, border-touching region; EDA E: the egg is brighter than its surrounding ring in 99% of images, i.e. locally bright

change: + white top-hat (disk r=60) then Otsu as the last cascade step
why: same diagnosis as T6; top-hat removes bright structures larger than an egg

change: solidity filter 0.85 -> 0.75
why: T6 failure review: clean egg blobs rejected (plants: solidity 0.82); EDA I: 5th percentile of egg-blob solidity is 0.77, background median 0.60, so the cut-off should sit just below 0.77
decision: discarded: CI crosses 0, wins = losses (more false blobs pass)

change: stronger opening, r=2 -> r=6
why: T6 failure review: the egg is joined to bright background by a narrow neck; a larger opening cuts it

change: split fused blobs: distance transform + watershed
why: same diagnosis as T9, using the standard touching-objects split instead of a bigger opening
decision: discarded: also cuts single eggs at the lit/shaded boundary

change: select the most central blob (+ others >= 0.5x its area) instead of all blobs
why: EDA B: eggs sit in the centre (P = 0.38 vs 0.01 at the edge); T6 keeps every blob that passes the filters, giving false extra eggs (count accuracy 0.64)
decision: kept: small gain, no losses, fewer false eggs

change: refine each egg with GrabCut (seeded: eroded blob = sure egg, blob = probably egg)
why: every trial so far has recall ~0.5: the shaded half of the egg is darker than the threshold; EDA C/D: egg pixels share one colour (low saturation), which GrabCut's colour model can follow

change: refine each egg with marker-based watershed on the colour image
why: same recall problem; EDA J: the egg outline is a Canny edge in most scenes, so flood from the blob to the nearest strong edge
decision: discarded: same score as T12; GrabCut kept because it can grow (T16) and serves the fallback (T17)

change: GrabCut may grow: band of 0.5 x egg radius around the blob marked 'probably egg'
why: T12/T13 still miss a third of each found egg (recall 0.68 on found eggs); the seed blob is only the lit half, so the refiner needs room to grow into the shaded half
decision: discarded: CI crosses 0; hurts dark backgrounds

change: watershed outer marker further out: 0.6 -> 1.0 x egg radius
why: same reason as T14, for the watershed

change: GrabCut grows (band 0.5) only when the cascade had to raise the threshold
why: T14 by cluster: growing helps bright/mid backgrounds (+0.05) but hurts dark ones (-0.05); on dark backgrounds plain Otsu already captures the whole egg, a raised threshold captures only its lit part

change: fallback when no blob is found: rectangle GrabCut on the central 60% box
why: 15 dev images still get no egg (IoU 0); EDA B: P(egg) = 0.38 in the centre vs 0.01 at the edge, and a rectangle is GrabCut's standard initialisation
decision: kept (final before ablation; simplified to S1)

change: ensemble: majority vote of seed blob, GrabCut and watershed per egg
why: T12 vs T13 win on different images (11 vs 12); test whether combining refiners helps
decision: discarded: majority vote pulls masks back to the lit half

change: benchmark: rectangle GrabCut on the central box only, no thresholding
why: T17's fallback works well; is the threshold cascade needed at all?
decision: discarded (benchmark): cascade needed; but wins on 18 images -> T20/T21

change: ensemble: run T17 and centre GrabCut, keep the one with higher inside-vs-ring contrast
